findings: The broad social corpus is generally compact and varied enough to retain; fan celebration, irritation, jokes, technical comments, and short live reactions coexist. The two standalone '红旗了。' roots are intentionally retained as independent updates, while their actual reply lines stay replies.

A small number of generated lines sounded like moderator/assistant corrections or tidy summaries. Revised only clear cases, including a paddock pit-entry question and a handful of overly explanatory replies; tags, conditions, IDs, slots, and reply links remain intact.

Two dynamic replies were excluded rather than stretched: one redundantly corrects a VSC parent that already states the control type, and one merely says the speaker has not seen a retirement cause while duplicating an existing cause question.

The active downloaded expression '你可以无惧失败' is an out-of-place life-coach imperative under a retirement post and is disabled by sourceId only. Downloaded source text was not edited; other short affective expressions were retained.

A targeted G1 follow-up removed clear player-instruction or mechanical-correction lines: yellow-flag safety advice, generic wait/don't-blame reminders, and a stale-read directive. Ordinary concern, cautious opinions, and data-oriented observations were retained. No broad rewrite was warranted; short reactions and technical remarks were not treated as defective by default. No clear real-person/organization references or fixed-result fabrication required bulk exclusion.
summary: Reviewed all 547 social template/fragment entries across the nine requested files (including 25 G1 downloaded-provenance fragments), plus the 21 distinct downloaded expressions used by runtime bindings. Edited 14 texts and two metadata-only placement annotations; excluded two weak generated dynamic replies and one unsuitable bound downloaded expression.
